Idlib | Ten Russian airstrikes hit Idlib’s outskirts and regime rockets kill civilian

Idlib province: The number of airstrikes carried out by Russian fighters on the northern outskirts of Idlib rose to nine, six of which fall on “Al-Sheikh Bahr” and three airstrikes hit west Maarat Masrin city. However, no casualties have been reported.

While SOHR activists have documented the death of a civilian due to a rocket attack carried out by regime forces on Maarbalit village in Jabal Al-Zawiyah, south of Idlib

SOHR sources have just reported that Russian fighter jets carried out four airstrikes on “Al-Sheikh Bahr” area on the northern outskirts of Idlib city.

These airstrikes coincided with intensive rocket fire by regime forces on areas in Jabal Al-Zawiyah, south of Idlib, wounding two civilians.
